problem: Alex and Jordan disagree about how to split household responsibilities after Jordan started working longer hours. Alex feels they're doing most of the chores alone; Jordan feels exhausted and criticized whenever they try to help.

user1.name: Alex
user1.background: Primary caregiver at home who tracks chores and schedules. Gets frustrated when effort goes unnoticed. Tends to reference past examples when feeling overwhelmed.
stated_goals: A plan that works with Jordan's new schedule

user2.name: Jordan
user2.background: Recently working longer hours and coming home depleted. Wants clear expectations instead of vague criticism. Avoids conflict until it boils over, then gets defensive.
stated_goals: Recognition for financial and emotional support
Not being blamed for every missed task
concerns: Never doing enough in Alex's eyes
